verdict.rationale: Antigravity's own agent is documented to edit code, run commands, and operate autonomously across editor, terminal, and browser, and it can delegate running tests to subagents. That gives the core agentic means to perform these maintenance tasks, but none of the four named tasks is specifically documented. Missing for 10: explicit docs for test generation, lint-error fixing, merge-conflict resolution, and dependency updates, plus any hands-on corroboration that the agent does these well.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent write tests, fix lint errors, resolve merge conflicts, and update dependencies for me

citations.quote: Build AI agents that autonomously read files, run commands, edit code, and more.
Able to autonomously operate across your editor, terminal, and browser.
an agent can delegate tasks—such as running tests or performing extensive codebase searches—to dedicated subagents.
Tell your agents what you need, and they’ll work on getting it done.
